T: Rebellions are built on hope. And snacks.
D: A band of rebels sets out to steal the plans for the Death Star.
P: Serve the snacks when the team walks through the crowded streets of Jedha.
S: Grilled za'atar flatbreads with hummus, pickled turnips and olives
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar, grilled until blistered, with hummus, pickled turnips and olives.
Garlic chili lime shrimp grilled on skewers, with mango cilantro salsa
Prawns marinated in garlic, chilli and lime for 20 minutes, threaded onto skewers and grilled until pink and charred, with a mango and coriander salsa.
the Erso family farm on Lah'mu

Crisp little potato and onion rösti fried golden in butter, topped with sour cream, chives and a spoon of hot smoked trout. Grate 800g potatoes and a small onion, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can in a tea towel. Mix with an egg, 2 tbsp flour and salt. Fry spoonfuls in butter and oil, flattening them, for 3 minutes a side until crisp and golden. Drain on paper. Top each with sour cream, flaked hot smoked trout from 150g and snipped chives.
M: Lamb, carrots and basmati rice cooked with cumin and cinnamon

Basmati cooked with cumin and cinnamon spiced lamb, carrot and onion, piled on a platter with raisins, toasted almonds and a garlic yoghurt. Brown 600g diced lamb in oil. Add a sliced onion, 2 carrots cut into strips, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp cinnamon and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 300g rinsed basmati and 600ml chicken stock, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes, then rest 10 minutes. Toast 50g flaked almonds. Pile onto a platter with 50g raisins and the almonds, and serve with yoghurt mixed with a crushed garlic clove.
Yavin 4 rebel base chicken rice bowls
the rebel base on Yavin 4 where Rogue One gets its call sign

Smoky paprika and garlic chicken charred on the grill, sliced over rice with black beans, charred corn, avocado, pickled onion and lime crema. Rub 800g chicken thighs with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt. Cook 300g rice. Slice a red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Warm a drained can of black beans with cumin. Grill the chicken 5 minutes a side and slice. Build bowls with avocado, pickled onion and sour cream mixed with lime.
W: Chocolate mousse set in round molds under a dark chocolate glaze
Dark chocolate mousse set in round moulds, glazed with a shiny grey-black ganache, one little dent pressed into each.
K: Green tea steeped with fresh ginger and honey, served hot or iced
Green tea brewed with ginger and honey, served hot in small cups or iced on a warm night.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: limes, one juiced and one for salsa

steps.text: Toss the prawns with the garlic, chilli and juice of 1 lime. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Dice the mango and mix with coriander and the juice of the second lime for the salsa.
Thread the prawns onto skewers and grill until pink and charred. Serve with the salsa.

dishes.make_ahead: Pilaf can be reheated, serve with fresh almonds

steps.text: Brown the lamb in the oil. Add the onion, carrots, cumin and cinnamon and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and stock, cover and cook on low.
Rest the pilaf, covered, for 10 minutes. Toast the almonds meanwhile.
Pile onto a platter with the raisins and almonds. Serve with yoghurt mixed with the garlic.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the day before, chill overnight

steps.text: Melt the mousse chocolate and whisk in the yolks. Whip the whites with the sugar and fold in with the whipped cream.
Spoon into 4 round moulds and set overnight.
Melt the glaze chocolate with the thickened cream and cocoa. Turn out the spheres and glaze them. Press a dent in each.
Steep the green tea and ginger in the hot water for 3 minutes.
Strain and stir in the honey.
Serve hot in small cups, or chill and pour over ice. I am one with the Force.

s.note: Grilled za'atar flatbreads with hummus, pickled turnips and olives
s.how: Brush 4 flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill until blistered at the edges. Cut into wedges and serve with a tub of hummus, pickled turnips and kalamata olives in little bowls.

s.note: Garlic chili lime shrimp grilled on skewers, with mango cilantro salsa
s.how: Toss 600g peeled green prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, a chopped chilli and the juice of a lime and marinate 20 minutes. Thread onto skewers and grill until pink and charred. Dice a mango with coriander and lime for salsa.

m.note: Lamb, carrots and basmati rice cooked with cumin and cinnamon
m.how: Brown 600g diced lamb in oil. Add a sliced onion, 2 carrots cut into strips, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp cinnamon and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 300g rinsed basmati and 600ml chicken stock, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes, then rest 10 minutes. Toast 50g flaked almonds. Pile onto a platter with 50g raisins and the almonds, and serve with yoghurt mixed with a crushed garlic clove.

w.note: Chocolate mousse set in round molds under a dark chocolate glaze
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate, whisk in 2 yolks, then fold in 2 whites whipped with 40g sugar and 150ml whipped cream. Set in 4 round moulds overnight. Turn out and glaze with 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream and a little cocoa. Press a dent in each.

d.note: Green tea steeped with fresh ginger and honey, served hot or iced
d.how: Steep 4 tsp green tea with a sliced knob of ginger in 1L water at about 80C for 3 minutes. Strain and stir in 2 tbsp honey. Serve hot in small cups, or chill and pour over ice. I am one with the Force.
